name: Drush language negotiation
description: When enabled this reset the language that Drush is using to the default language of the website.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Drush language negotiation 
 When importing configuration files via Drush we had the issue that when importing configuration like webform config files our default language of the website wasn't taken into account (Which was Dutch - NL). Drush was thinking the site was in ENG.

 This module resets the language to the default language of the website.

 Back to top 

 How to use 
 Enable the language negotiator on: "/admin/config/regional/language/detection"

Then when importing configuration via Drush (this language negotiator only works with Drush ) this negotiator reset the language to the default language of the website.
